# Clinical Trial & FDA Regulatory Data API

> Token-optimized, real-time structured data feeds covering FDA drug approvals and clinical trial updates. Designed specifically for AI agent context windows.

## Base Endpoint
https://yourdomain.com/api/v1/fda-tracker

## Access & Monetization
- **Autonomous Agents (x402 Protocol):** Pay-per-call micro-transactions ($0.05 USDC on Base Network, Chain ID 8453). Pass payment headers automatically.
- **Developer API Key (SaaS):** Unlimited access for $199/month. Pass via `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`. Get a key at https://yourdomain.com/dashboard.

## Parameters
- `limit`: Number of records to return (default: 20)
- `condition`: Filter by disease or condition (e.g., `?condition=Alzheimer`)

## Output Format
Clean, flattened JSON payloads engineered to eliminate redundant markup and minimize token usage.
